purpose: Freeze representative referral list, filter, facet, ordering, and cursor behavior across local-file and PostgreSQL adapters before store boundaries move.
boundedContract: Search selects the same three synthetic referral records on both adapters.
Client-name ascending order returns the same records in the same order.
A two-record page exposes a sort-bound cursor; the next page returns only the remaining record and preserves the full matching total.
County, owner, priority, and tag filters compose to the same one-record result.
Community, county, owner, priority, stage, tag, and workspace-month facets return the same values and counts.
claimBoundary: This representative sample does not cover every list option, every sort, archived/deleted workspaces, every queue or workflow filter, file projections, malformed cursors, or query-plan performance.
